text: Nouryon (formerly AkzoNobel Specialty Chemicals) is a privately held Dutch specialty chemicals group bought in 2018 for EUR 10.1bn and jointly owned by private-equity firm The Carlyle Group and GIC, Singapore's sovereign wealth fund. The Singapore state fund is therefore a co-controlling shareholder, giving a genuine partial state stake without the sponsor becoming a state entity. Human-rights relevance is indirect: chemical manufacturing exposure, but the ownership chain runs into a sovereign fund.
